Order/reference ID: [Order ID]
Product/service: [Product/service]
Purchase/order date: [Purchase date]

Reported incident date (confirm what this date refers to): [Incident date]

Amount reported for this grievance (confirm whether price, payment or refund): [Amount in INR]

[Timeline not provided]

[Add previous communication only if it happened; otherwise say 'not contacted']

Thank you,
[Your name]
[Your contact details]
